name: Mikado Takeru
source:
Second-year student of Akitsu High School. The protagonist of the main story. Due to certain circumstances, he lives at his cousin Shiori's house. For a long time, he has been tormented by mysterious nightmares, but with Mayou appearance, the situation gradually begins to change...
